problem_statement: The Creative Tim Paper Dashboard 2 admin template is a directly runnable static Bootstrap dashboard. Its operations views host an Ops focus console: a card that sits in the dashboard widget zone (examples/dashboard.html) and is echoed onto the User Profile (examples/user.html) and Table List (examples/tables.html) pages. The console has a window filter (Today / This week / This month / Quarter), a live summary readout ('Showing: <window> - <n> alerts open'), and a row of four metric tiles (Uptime, Latency p95, Alerts open, Deploys). Three regressions were filed against it and must be repaired together, editing only the console's own stylesheet (assets/css/ops-focus.css), its script (assets/js/ops-focus.js), and the per-page includes that render it. (1) RESPONSIVE: on 390px mobile the segment row and tile row are pinned to a fixed width and do not wrap, so the dashboard page overflows horizontally. (2) INTERACTION: clicking a window filter re-highlights the segment and updates the tiles, but the summary readout is frozen on its initial 'Today' snapshot and never re-syncs to the clicked window. (3) CROSS-PAGE: the console is missing from some of the pages that are supposed to carry it. Repair the console so its rows reflow within the viewport on desktop, tablet and 390px mobile; so the readout updates live to the selected window; and so the console renders consistently on the dashboard, user profile and table pages - without changing the surrounding profile card, team list, edit form, dashboard stat cards, Chart.js canvases, sidebar, navbar, or any other content.
required_content: On mobile (390px) the examples/dashboard.html page must have no horizontal overflow beyond the small tolerance; the Ops focus console segment row and metric tile row must wrap or shrink to fit inside the viewport.

Clicking a window segment (e.g. 'This month') must update the live summary readout so it reflects the selected window (e.g. 'Showing: This month'), not stay frozen on the initial 'Today' snapshot; the active segment and metric tiles must update in step.
The Ops focus console must render on the dashboard, user profile and table list pages consistently (same card, filter, readout and four tiles); it must not be dropped from any of those pages.
Desktop and tablet layouts of the console must remain intact (four tiles in a clean row/grid, legible labels and values) and visually consistent with the surrounding Paper Dashboard cards.

Keep the original Paper Dashboard 2 sidebar, Creative Tim logo, dashboard stat cards, Chart.js canvases, notification navbar, user cover image, profile avatar, team member list, Edit Profile form, footer links, and local CSS/JS assets intact and free of new runtime console/network errors. Use the existing static architecture only; do not add a framework, package manager, backend, build output, or remote asset dependency.
design_constraints: Treat this as an L4 repair that must fix a responsive overflow, a stale interactive readout, and a cross-page presence gap on the same Ops focus console component, without redesigning the dashboard.
Fit Paper Dashboard 2 conventions: Bootstrap cards, light gray dashboard background, rounded corners, compact card-category labels, the teal (#51cbce) accent for the active filter and readout.
The console lives in the existing dashboard widget zone (between the stat cards and the charts) and remains part of the operations workflow on every page that carries it.

Do not rely on hiding the console, clipping the document, overlapping the tiles, or removing tiles to hide the overflow; the segments, readout and tiles must remain visible, legible and non-overlapping at every viewport.
state_constraints: desktop_dashboard, tablet_dashboard and mobile_dashboard protect the dashboard route, sidebar, stat cards, Chart.js canvases, navbar, responsive shell, and the Ops focus console laid out cleanly.
mobile_dashboard is the responsive discriminator: after the repair the 390px dashboard has no horizontal overflow beyond tolerance; the unrepaired console overflows.
desktop_console_focus is the interaction discriminator: after clicking the 'This month' segment the summary readout must read 'Showing: This month'; the frozen readout does not update.
desktop_user and desktop_tables protect the user profile and table pages and verify the console renders consistently there (cross-page presence discriminator).

change_completion: The mobile dashboard has no horizontal overflow beyond tolerance and the console rows reflow to fit.
Clicking a window segment updates the live readout to the selected window instead of leaving it frozen on 'Today'.
design_consistency: The console uses Paper Dashboard card hierarchy, card-category labels, light gray surfaces, rounded tiles, and the teal active-filter accent.
Desktop, tablet, dashboard, user profile and table navigation remain recognizable and consistent.
responsive: Desktop, tablet and 390px mobile captures of the dashboard have no horizontal overflow beyond tolerance.
The segment row and four metric tiles wrap cleanly on 390px mobile and do not overlap, clip, or displace the stat cards or charts.
regression: Sidebar route labels, dashboard stat cards, chart canvases, navbar, profile cover/avatar images, team list, Edit Profile form, footer links, and local CSS/JS remain intact.
No package metadata, dependency additions, backend, build output, remote media, or console/network errors are introduced.

scoring_notes: A correct patch fixes all three regressions on the same Ops focus console: it makes the segment and tile rows wrap/shrink so the mobile dashboard has no horizontal overflow; it wires the window filter so the live readout re-syncs to the selected window (not a frozen 'Today' snapshot); and it renders the console consistently on the dashboard, user profile and table pages. It preserves the console's content and the surrounding dashboard, charts, sidebar and assets, and introduces no console or network errors. A page that still overflows on mobile, a readout that stays frozen after a click, a console missing from one of its pages, or a layout that overlaps/clips/hides the tiles should not pass.

metadata.design_goal: repair a responsive overflow, a stale interactive readout, and a cross-page presence gap on a native dashboard operations console while preserving existing dashboard structure, routes, and assets
metadata.selected_repo_reason: Creative Tim Paper Dashboard 2 is a runnable static Bootstrap admin dashboard whose widget zone naturally hosts an operations console (KPI tiles + a window filter); this makes it a genre-native L4 dashboard_admin repair spanning responsive layout, interactive state, and cross-page continuity.
